title: The Clairaudiograph
subtitle: A voice cut into wax
text: Place a filled creature Blood Vial and a blank Ambergris Cylinder in the Clairaudiograph. Select a call and carve for four seconds. Identification is not required. The blood is consumed and its empty vial remains. Preview is private; Play carries the recording up to 32 blocks. A rising redstone edge plays once. Enable Loop to repeat while powered, or use Play for a manual loop. Stop affects this machine alone. A cylinder preserves a sound event, so its audio variation can change between plays. Make two cylinders from Mnemonic Ambergris, Active Befouling Ash, honeycomb wax, and paper.
